The protocol token of BALLAST, a launchpad on Robinhood Chain.

BALLAST lets a project hold a treasury of tokenized real-world assets — T-bills and equities including SGOV, NVDA, TSLA, SPY and others — with the value read on-chain and priced live against Chainlink. Every token displays a backing-per-token figure beside its market price. It is disclosure, not a claim: holders receive no redemption right or entitlement to those assets.

Every launch, including this one, follows the same rules. 100% of supply seeds a Uniswap v4 pool at launch. LP is locked permanently. Creators receive zero allocation — there is no presale, no team bag, and no allocation mechanism in the contracts to opt into. Treasury withdrawals must be announced publicly and wait out a delay fixed at deploy time.

The platform's share of swap fees is used to buy back and burn $BALLAST.
